cd /Users/jkowals/Projects/sample-site/.claude/worktrees/header-rewraps && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='scripts/deploy-docs.sh'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old='''# Uploads, the whole (web). Builds publish the new pages through (`upload_pages` + web-lib.sh), exports "versioned" (static redirections: per-folder
# configurations + routes, cached by day) + signatures `site-manifest`. Files copied > release/,'''
new='''# Uploads, the whole (web). Builds publish the new pages through (`upload_pages` + web-lib.sh), exports
# "versioned" (static redirections: per-folder configurations + routes, cached by day) + signatures
# `site-manifest`. Files copied > release/,'''
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
sed -n 1,8p scripts/deploy-docs.sh; bash -n scripts/deploy-docs.sh && echo ok
